name: SavePerCard
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/SavePerCard
summary: A long configuration page split into titled cards that each own their save: the platform shell, a page heading, then one `CardBox` per topic with an info `Message`, stacked label-and-control fields inside a fieldset, and a footer whose secondary Save commits that card alone, beside an optional docs `Link`. Project Settings is the example, with Preview Toolbar and Deployment Protection. Built from the platform shell, `CardBox`, `Message`, `Label`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Link` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneCard
variants.summary: Preview Toolbar is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its selects are disabled, while Deployment Protection stays editable.
